## Checklist

- [ ] Official share link is live: `https://x.ai/bot/…`
- [ ] Name in the PR matches the share page
- [ ] One-line description only (no prompt body, config, or memory dump)
- [ ] Category is one of the README sections
- [ ] Twitter handle included only if it is already public (otherwise `null`)
- [ ] No secrets or personal data
- [ ] `data/templates.json` updated
- [ ] Same row added to every README, name linking only to the share URL
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py` passes
